resources.string: This game consists of two or more teams playing against each other. Each team consists of two players. First player explains the word to the second player without using the root word. If the second player guesses the word, they get a point. The game goes on until set time or point limit. Team that goes through all words in the least amount of time with most points is the winner.

With the incredibly popular Alias game, you get a whopping 3,200 words to explain and guess, ensuring the game remains exciting for a long time. Featuring a rich selection of words from categories such as Objects and things, People and professions, Adjectives and Verbs, the game also includes words from everyday life, the world of sports and recreation, entertainment, culture, and many more.
WILL YOUR EXPLANATION SCORE A GOAL?\nDive into the fantastic world of football! From heel kicks to shots on goal, Alias Football puts your vocabulary to the test in a fantastic way!

Dobrodošli u čarobni svijet Hrvatske kulture, gdje ćemo koristiti riječi i imena od prošlosti do sadašnjosti kao ključeve za otkrivanje tajni. Razmišljajte kao rječnički čarobnjaci dok koristite riječi poput \\"kralj Tomislav\\" i \\"Franjo Tuđman\\" te likove kao \\"profesor Baltazar\\" i \\"Mate Rimac\\" kako biste osvojili bodove u ovoj uzbudljivoj igri HR Alias.\n Vaš zadatak je prenositi suštinu Hrvatske kulture kroz kreativne opise, sinonime, ili suprotna značenja kako biste pomogli svojim partnerima da pogode što više riječi prije nego što vrijeme istekne. Kroz ovu igru prepunu uzbuđenja, možete otkriti prave riječi i postati tim pobjednika u igri Alias! Započnite svoju avanturu i pokažite svoju maštovitost!

Dobrodošli u čarobni svet srpske kulture — od istorije do današnjih dana. Koristite reči i imena poput „Nikola Tesla“, „Sveti Sava“, „Novak Đoković“, „Kalemegdan“ i „ćevapi“ kao ključeve za pogađanje pojmova i osvajanje bodova u uzbudljivoj igri Alias Srbija.\n

Alias Spain puts your knowledge of everything Spanish to the test!\n\nFrom paella, jamón and churros to the Alhambra, the Camino de Santiago and the Sagrada Família. From San Fermín, the Fallas and the Feria de Abril to Cervantes, Goya, Dalí and Almodóvar. Football, flamenco, Nadal and Los 40 Principales — six hundred cards of Spain.

Alias Slovenija preizkuša tvoje besedišče in poznavanje vsega, kar je slovensko!\n\nZ besedami in imeni iz priljubljenih otroških pravljicnih in literarnih junakov, Martina Krpana, Radovednega Tačka in Cicibana, pa do spoznavanja slovenskih kulturnih spomenikov, krajev, posebnosti, najbolj priljubljenih serij, knjig, jedi in slavnih ljudi. Alias Slovenija preizkuša tvoje besedišče in poznavanje vsega, kar je slovensko!

Alias Italy puts your knowledge of everything Italian to the test!\n\nFrom carbonara, espresso and tiramisù to the Colosseum, the Duomo and the Cinque Terre. From Fellini, Sophia Loren and Sanremo to Ferrari, Vespa and the Giro d\'Italia. A thousand cards of Italy, from north to south.

Alias France puts your knowledge of everything French to the test!\n\nFrom the baguette, the croissant and camembert to the Eiffel Tower, Mont-Saint-Michel and the châteaux of the Loire. From Napoléon, Victor Hugo and Édith Piaf to Zidane, the Tour de France and the Festival de Cannes. A thousand cards of France, from Brittany to Provence.

UK Alias - the exciting game where you explain words and learn more about the country you love the best!

How much do you know about the UK? This exciting word game requires players to explain words and learn more about the country you love the best!

With 1,800 words about UK sports, culture history and much more, this game is perfect for the whole family.

Explain words and images to your team members using words with the same, similar, or opposite meanings, mimicking sounds or actions, and more. This game can also be played by children who cannot yet read, as there are corresponding pictures next to the words. Each team tries to guess as many words as possible before the time runs out on the hourglass. Play this fast, dynamic, and insanely fun game!\nAlias Junior is a game for the whole family!

Taboo, my friends, is the ultimate party word extravaganza! Picture this: you and your pals huddled around, trying to describe some wacky word or phrase from a card without dropping four super obvious hints that are also on the card.

But wait, there's more! Your rivals are there too, keeping a keen eye on the clock, ready to buzz you like a pesky mosquito if you let those forbidden words slip from your lips or if you decide to pull out your best interpretive dance moves.

The thrill is real, folks! For every card your team conquers, you earn yourself a precious point. It's like a wordy battle of wits, and it's an absolute blast! So, if you're on the hunt for a party game that'll have you laughing, yelling, and maybe even doing some ninja-like word acrobatics, Taboo is your ticket to an epic evening!

CAN YOUR EXPLANATION DELIVER A SLAM DUNK?\nEnter the electrifying world of the NBA, where every word counts as much as every point. From buzzer beaters and fast breaks to slam dunks, legendary teams and iconic players, Alias NBA brings the thrill of basketball to your table and challenges your skills in a truly exciting way.

LIGHTS, CAMERA, ACTION!\nStep into the dazzling world of cinema, where every clue is a scene and every guess could be a blockbuster. From timeless classics and cult favorites to Hollywood stars and unforgettable lines, Alias Movies turns your game night into a red-carpet event and challenges your knowledge in the most entertaining way.

CAN YOU GUESS WHO YOU ARE?\nStep into the shoes of the world\'s most famous faces — from movie stars, athletes and musicians to cartoon heroes, historical legends and everyday characters. In Who Am I? every clue points to a famous name, and it\'s up to your team to guess it before time runs out. A hilarious, fast-paced guessing game that puts your pop-culture knowledge to the ultimate test.
Welcome to the world of Bosnia and Herzegovina — from ćevapi and burek to sevdah, Baščaršija and the national football team. Describe people, places and words to score points in Alias BiH.
Two or more teams face off. Each team has two players who take turns explaining and guessing.
One player describes the word to their teammate — without ever saying the word itself or its root.
If your teammate guesses it, your team scores a point. Stuck on one? Skip it and keep going.
Play to a time or point limit. The team that finishes with the most points in the least time wins!

Willkommen in der Welt des deutschen Alltags — von Feierabend und Pfandautomat bis Tatort, Bundesliga und Weihnachtsmarkt. Erklärt Begriffe und Namen wie „Currywurst“, „Schrebergarten“, „Reeperbahn“, „Helene Fischer“ und „Digga“, lasst euer Team raten und sammelt Punkte im großen Alias Deutschland.\n

Over 1,000 words. Three difficulty levels. No idea what’s coming next. Easy words are worth 1 point, medium words 2, and hard words 3. Keep your cool, explain fast, and turn every word into points before time runs out.

Get creative with the drawing tools, race against the clock, and see if your drawing is good enough to be guessed in time. Dirty minds. Quick thinking. Zero shame. 🌶️

Alias Words: After Dark turns innocent explanations into very adult conversations. Team up with friends and describe the word without saying it — using clues you'd never say in polite company. Guess as many as you can and leave your inhibitions at the door.

Get three words right in a single round and you'll reach CLIMAX, where every word is worth 2 points. Ready to go all the way?
